facts.fact: The assize hearing in the hall is held at noon, two days after the return from the Resin House, in daylight so Chathu is ungagged.
facts.why: needed because Chathu is gagged from sunset to dawn (ch 28) and must testify by day.

facts.fact: Rema keeps a second sealed case tied in green thread at her feet, unopened during the assize; she glances at it when Devan mentions the seal.
facts.why: plants the sealed writ opened in ch 30 (clue C21).

facts.fact: The night before the assize Devan told Neela he would put the lookout leaf before Rema himself, bearing the cost; she did not answer.
facts.why: makes her unasked standing a choice against his offer.
